environment.description: Same Lambda and API Gateway deployment, but fronted by a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with a target group health check on /health. The NLB has a VPC Security Group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b3d5e7f9) attached with inbound rules allowing TCP/443 only from three CIDR blocks: 10.200.0.0/16 (corporate VPN egress), 172.20.128.0/20 (CI/CD runner subnet), and 192.168.50.0/24 (on-prem monitoring). The NLB is internal-facing (scheme: internal) within vpc-0f1e2d3c4b5a6789. There is no internet gateway route in the NLB subnet route table (rtb-0abcdef123456789). DNS resolution for the API endpoint (pipeline-api.internal.corp.example.com) is served only by Route 53 private hosted zone associated with the VPC. No VPC peering or transit gateway attachment exists to any VPC with public internet access.
